# Lancaster Tree Removal Pros

## About
Lancaster Tree Removal Pros is a licensed and insured tree service company serving Lancaster County, PA. We handle tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, and emergency storm response for residential and commercial properties. We offer 24/7 emergency service for fallen trees and storm damage throughout the county.

## Services
- Tree Removal (all sizes — dead, diseased, hazardous, or obstructing)
- Tree Trimming and Pruning (crown reduction, canopy thinning, dead branch removal)
- Stump Grinding (ground down 6-12 inches below grade for replanting or paving)
- Emergency Tree Service (24/7 response for storm damage and fallen trees)
- Lot Clearing (land prep for new construction, additions, and driveways)
- Tree Health Assessment (diagnosis of disease, pest damage, and structural risk)
- Debris Hauling and Cleanup

## Service Area
Lancaster, Lititz, Ephrata, Manheim, Mount Joy, Elizabethtown, Millersville, Columbia, Lancaster County, PA

## Why Choose Us
Licensed and fully insured in Pennsylvania, with over 15 years working trees in Lancaster County. We provide proof of insurance before any work begins. We clean up completely after every job — debris, wood, and brush hauled away. Emergency line is staffed 24 hours, not an answering service.
